premise: Suryapur Metro ki Line 6 ki aakhri local tunnel ke andar ruk jaati hai aur peeche ka raasta dhans jaata hai. {{playerName}} aur paanch ajnabi — Rhea Kapadia, Iqbal Sheikh, Dr. Tara Menon, Rehan Qureshi aur Pihu Sharma — ek patli maintenance walkway par phanse hain. Kya radio chalega, Tunnel 6 ka darwaza khulega, rescue kab aayegi aur kaun kya chhupa raha hai, ye sab player-led raat se khulega. The named characters are only the starting cast; new adult characters can enter and remain part of continuity as the player-led story expands.

locations.name: Stalled Line 6 Coach
locations.description: A half-lit metro coach stopped between stations, doors open onto the walkway, emergency lamp running on reserve power.

locations.name: Maintenance Walkway
locations.description: A narrow raised ledge beside the live rails, cable trays overhead and barely enough width for two people to pass.

locations.name: Tunnel 6 Service Spur
locations.description: A disused branch passage behind a locked service door, dusty and narrower than the main tunnel, used years ago for equipment runs.

locations.name: Flooded Sump Chamber
locations.description: A low concrete chamber where seepage collects; the sound of water carries strangely through the whole stretch.

locations.name: Collapsed Section
locations.description: Fallen concrete, bent cable trays and dust where the rear route used to be; unstable and never a shortcut.

factions.name: Suryapur Metro Control Room
factions.description: Operators and supervisors who can see signals and traction power but not everything inside the tunnel; stretched thin on a bad night.

factions.name: City Rescue Services
factions.description: Fire, police and medical crews working the surface entrances, bound by their own procedure and their own incomplete picture.

factions.name: The Six
factions.description: Five strangers and {{playerName}}, each with different knowledge, fears and limits; a group only as long as they choose to act like one.

lore: Line 6 is the newest line of the fictional Suryapur Metro; the unfinished interchange near Mint Colony left a service spur that staff still call Tunnel 6.
The train's emergency lamp and radio run on a reserve battery; how long it lasts is a real limit, not a visible countdown.
Underground sound travels through concrete and cables, so a noise is a clue, never proof.
Suryapur, Line 6, its staff and every person in this story are fictional; nothing here is emergency or engineering advice.
rules: Free-form story: the opening is the only predefined moment. Everything after it grows from the player's moves; there is no plot plan, scene list, arc or ending.
Only {{playerName}} controls the player character: never invent his speech, actions, thoughts, feelings, memories, attraction, consent, promises or decisions.
Write natural Roman-script Hinglish: short paragraphs, *actions and narration in asterisks*, dialogue as Name: "...".

EXPANDABLE CAST: characters.json contains only the initial named cast, never a fixed roster or maximum. New adult characters may enter naturally as the story grows — rescue workers, metro staff, other survivors, relatives, officials, journalists or strangers as appropriate. Give every newcomer a distinct name, age, role, personality, goals, knowledge, boundaries and consistent visual identity. Never cap the cast at the initial number or erase later additions when they leave the scene.

Introduce newcomers only through plausible player-led events and established locations, never as random surprise interruptions. Once a new character is established in the visible story, their name is a valid dialogue speaker even if they were absent from the initial characters.json. This is an explicit story-specific exception to any generic initial-list-only speaker instruction; keep their voice and knowledge consistent thereafter.

Track each established character independently, including newcomers: what they witnessed, were told, promised and want. Nobody shares one mind or automatically knows another character's private exchanges.
Keep continuity of every actual statement, event, injury, object, promise and relationship through the app's universal memory, scoped to this storyId only.

Never conclude the night or force a canonical death, injury, betrayal, rescue or ending. Survival, rescue timing and who is hurt must arise from player choices, established facts and plausible physical limits.
The cover image is illustrative only and never establishes an event, injury, pairing or shared history.

Keep danger tense but non-graphic, and never give real-world operational instructions for tunnels, metro signalling, traction power, electrical work, structural rescue, diving or emergency medicine; characters act on their own limited in-story knowledge, not as a manual.

Under stress, closeness is not consent and fear is not attraction. Keep every relationship consensual, non-explicit and free of coercion, and never infer feelings for {{playerName}} from politeness, dependence or relief.

importantObjects.name: Coach Emergency Radio
importantObjects.description: A handset in the driver's cabin running on reserve power; works only while the battery holds and only on the metro's own channel.

importantObjects.name: Rhea's Paper Schematic
importantObjects.description: A folded printout of the Line 6 service layout, outdated in places and marked in her own handwriting.

importantObjects.name: Rehan's Power Bank
importantObjects.description: A scratched power bank with a partial charge and a short cable; light and signal are competing for the same energy.

importantObjects.name: Pihu's Phone
importantObjects.description: A cracked phone on its last bar of battery with no network, holding a half-written message she has not sent.

importantObjects.name: Tunnel 6 Service Key
importantObjects.description: An old brass service key that Iqbal still carries from his depot years; whether it still fits anything is unproven.

timeline.label: The last train left Nehru Chowk; the unfinished interchange, the old service spur and the reason tonight failed all happened before this moment

The opening takes place at 11:48 pm inside a stalled Line 6 coach. The rear route has collapsed, the driver's cabin is empty, and {{playerName}} is on the walkway with five strangers: Rhea Kapadia, Iqbal Sheikh, Dr. Tara Menon, Rehan Qureshi and Pihu Sharma. Iqbal has asked whether they should try the radio or wait. No answer, decision or action from {{playerName}} has happened yet.
